description: Calculate one person’s daily noise exposure (LEP,d) from measured task levels (LAeq in dB(A)) and how long each lasts, or from dosemeter readings, and which action value it reaches (80 and 85 dB(A)). Optionally gives the weekly LEP,w, compares peak dB(C), and estimates noise at the ear against the 87 dB(A) limit from hearing protection SNR or H/M/L with each task’s C-weighted level. Do not use sound power LwA or per-shot values; omitted peak or protection measurements remain explicitly unassessed. Returns a link that opens the same calculation in the noise calculator.

peak.description: Highest measured C-weighted peak sound pressure level in dB(C).

protector.description: Hearing-protector attenuation from its SNR or H/M/L ratings.

tasks.description: Measured tasks for one person in one day; 1 to 10 entries.

label.description: Short human-readable label or stable slug, up to 60 characters.

level.description: Measured task-equivalent continuous A-weighted sound level, LAeq in dB(A).

levelC.description: Measured C-weighted task level in dB(C), needed to estimate protection at the ear.

minutes.description: Actual exposure time in minutes, not the whole shift.

protectionWorn.description: Whether hearing protection is worn during this task; defaults to false.

label.description: Short human-readable label or stable slug, up to 60 characters.

levelC.description: Measured C-weighted task level in dB(C), needed to estimate protection at the ear.

minutes.description: Exposure time represented. Defaults to measuredMinutes.

protectionWorn.description: Whether hearing protection is worn during this task; defaults to false.

reading.description: Dosemeter reading in that unit: 0.0001 to 10000 Pa²h, or 0.0001 to 100000%.

unit.description: pa2h: sound exposure in Pa²h. dose85 or dose80: percentage dose referenced to 85 or 80 dB(A) over 8 hours.

days.description: Number of days, from 1 to 7, on which this calculated daily exposure repeats.

levels.description: Daily LEP,d values in dB(A), one for each exposed day, maximum 7.

week.description: Repeat the calculated day this many days, or supply the daily LEP,d for each exposed day.

name: noise_daily_exposure

limit.description: What the result does not establish.

source.description: ComplyOnSite page that shows the same answer.

summary.description: The answer in one to three plain sentences, the figure or code first.

title: Calculate daily noise exposure
